_comment: Synthetic Birdie Time example (illustrative, not a production round; the three-entry catalogue is a test fixture) on the golden-vector seed (link index 1 of the fairness chain, so chainIndex 1 walks to the root). Three independent draws over one committed seed: the card (which golfer priced the round), the pattern (which of the 8 putt patterns happened — the count/exact markets pay on it) and the round type (plain/frost/fire — the side market pays on it). The board is priced from the card's make rate, and the paytable hash bound those prices at round open. Feed it to verify.html or `node examples/verify-example.mjs examples/birdie-verified.json` — it reproduces pattern MMM (index 7), round type frost, card e02 (make rate 500000), the paytable hash, and the verdict is VERIFIED. `catalogue` is where the published registry row's entries go; without it the card draw is still recomputed and the make rate is taken as published.
